board_scope: The accessible Altium design is WISP5.0-LRG. The official WISP5.1 schematic and pinout links returned HTTP 404 on 2026-10-12. The accelerometer example's 5.1 EPC byte does not establish a 5.1 circuit.
stock_energy_basis: C2 is 47 uF on CPOUT; U1 is S-882Z24 with schematic Value=2.4v. Calculate energy at that named voltage only, not a guaranteed usable energy or an upper bound on its eventual voltage under RF input.
controller_current_basis: MSP430FR5969 SLAS704G section 5.4 typical FRAM_UNI currents at 3.0 V and 1/12/16 MHz. They are scale scenarios, not WISP board currents at 2.2 V or upper bounds. Continuous 1 MHz activity during acquisition is assumed; GPIO load, RF analog front end, level translation, NVS commits, regulators, startup and reservoir leakage are not included.
rf_time_basis: Count one EPC response per channel from PC/EPC/CRC plus FM0 preamble/end, with and without TRext. Query/RN16/ACK exchanges, receive listening, reader scheduling, application confirmation and retries are additional. There is no bounded total RF time without a reader trace.
energy_architecture: An added 5.0-to-4.5 V reservoir feeding separate linear supply rails. This is a supply design scenario, not the stock WISP power path. No harvested power or wireless range is assumed.
